name: post-write-enforce
description: Reminds AGENTS.md Rule 6 (Scope & Post-Write). After a write or edit touches a path containing .agents/, sets a flag. Fail-open: the next non-shell tool call is blocked ONCE with a reminder to run post-write.sh, then the flag is cleared; a successful shell command running post-write.sh also clears it. Exempt: log.md, CHANGELOG.md, index.md files.
